title: The EmDash kit tool reads bracketed stamps, pager links, shared labels, term pages, repeater types, kept slot fit and carousel rows
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Each kit-tool defect of the four JA ports (B to I) is read as fixed on a synthetic fixture, and Joomla and WordPress queries and sliders read as before.

tests: B: an EmDash pager address keeps its page number; page 1 is the list
B: Joomla and WordPress read every query as before, `?page=N` included
B: the "2" pager link of an EmDash list is a pagination control once its page is a kit page
C and D: words two slots share name the slot the stamps also place in the link’s own block
E: a link to the page the map gives a taxonomy term is a term link, whatever its path
E: a term archive printing its term as h1 is titled by the term slot, via taxonomy-term
E: a term’s own page is titled by the term slot even when a card of its block prints the same words
E: a category and a tag both named Business: only the term of the page’s path is its title
G: two hero slides printing one h1 text: the first slide’s slot is the title
F: a repeater sub-field named link_title is text, btn_link_2 an address; the field map’s declared source wins
H: --write carries fit, customize, slotFitVersion and fitGroups over for unchanged slots only
D: a stamp in several blocks keeps every one of them as the slot’s alsoIn; the owner stays the first
I: a numbered modifier class does not split the row shape
I: a carousel’s hidden copies are no rows; hidden rows outside a slider still count
I: a slider showing a whole multiple of the declared rows matches that list on EmDash only, and only when no set has exactly its rows
I: keepRows finds the rows the reader counted: numbered modifiers and a slider’s hidden copies
